title: Devastator — The Boarding of Tantive IV
description: A 108-stud Imperial dagger with layered armor, a deep machinery trench, eight twin turbolasers, seven aft engines and twin shield globes. A miniature Tantive IV waits beneath the ventral docking bay.

sections.name: Triangular frame and ventral docking recess
Bonded ventral armor and curved outer chines
Shallow sloped dorsal armor and panel seams
T-shaped bridge and twin shield globes
Three main drives and four auxiliary engines
